notes:
After an update, a Diastema page that was already open now reloads itself the next time you go to another page, so it runs the new version right away. If a settings page has unsaved changes, it asks first.

Also in this beta (from 0.26.0-beta.8): card payments spread over the plan's procedures, the Pay in Advance discount written as Discount adjustments, a partial refund as one negative payment, and no browser pop-ups anywhere.
